description:
Issue summary:
Users clicking approval links from the desktop support portal are redirected to Okta SSO but fail to complete login due to a mismatch between the 'username' attribute in the SAML/OIDC assertion and the identity proxy's canonical lookup. Impact: approvers cannot complete access approvals for support tickets; approvals queue stalled for several teams.

Impact:
- ~25 unique approval attempts failed across multiple teams between 2026-03-09 22:00 and 2026-03-10 03:00 UTC.
- Approval emails open a link that uses a prefilled 'approver' principal; the Okta attribute normalization recently rolled out lowercases usernames which causes principal lookup to return 404/principal-not-found in identity-proxy.

Environment:
- Affected: prod support portal (us-west region).
- Identity proxy version: 2026-02-18-build-17.
- Okta tenant: redwood-production.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Receive approval email from support-portal with approval link (includes approver principal email in query string).
2) Click link (desktop/browser with SSO).
3) Redirect to Okta login/SSO happens, assertion returns and user is redirected back to support-portal.
4) Support-portal displays "Unable to resolve approver" and shows 403/approval-failed.

Observed logs (identity-proxy and support-portal):
- identity-proxy: "[2026-03-10T00:14:03Z] WARN principal lookup failed: lookup_key=\"j.smith@redwood.com\" normalized_key=\"j.smith@redwood.com\" returned=404"
- support-portal: "ERROR approval-handler: approver lookup mismatch for tokenId=tok_abc123: principal not found for claim 'preferred_username'"
- Okta assertion snippet (from syslog): "preferred_username: j.smith@redwood.com" and after transform "preferred_username: j.smith@redwood.com" (lowercased upstream by new rule)

Additional context:
- This surfaced immediately after an Okta attribute transform rule (lowercase-email) was rolled out in the tenant on 2026-03-09 at ~21:50 UTC to normalize legacy identities.
- The support-portal previously relied on case-preserving email matching; identity-proxy canonicalization expects mixed-case in some internal service accounts which led to a mismatch for approver prefill keys.
investigation_notes: 03/10 01:10 UTC - Triage by oncall: initial hypothesis is Okta attribute transformation changed casing for 'preferred_username' and 'email'.
03/10 01:22 UTC - Checked Okta logs: transform rule 'lowercase-email' applied to 100% of assertions starting 2026-03-09 21:50 UTC (admin: mark.lester@redwood.com).
03/10 01:35 UTC - Identity-proxy lookup shows strict-case matching of 'approverKey' in Redis; keys created by support-portal were mixed-case (legacy), so normalized assertion didn't match stored key.
03/10 02:05 UTC - Reproduced locally by creating approval link with 'J.Smith@redwood.com' then asserting 'j.smith@redwood.com' from Okta; identity-proxy returned principal-not-found.
03/10 02:30 UTC - Cross-checked related tickets and found similar symptom in INT-271001 (approval-link-redirects-fail-for-service-bot) — likely same root cause.

03/10 03:00 UTC - Prepared a mitigation plan: make identity-proxy lookup case-insensitive for email-based principals and add an immediate config toggle to enable case-insensitive matching for approver paths.
comments: Aisha Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-10 01:15: 'Multiple approvers reporting 403s when following approval emails. Created ticket and triaged.'
Liam Chen (Assignee) 2026-03-10 01:40: 'Investigating Okta attribute transforms and identity-proxy lookup logic; paging infra and identity.'

Mark Lester (Identity Admin) 2026-03-10 01:55: 'Confirmed I rolled out lowercase-email transform as part of cleanup. Rolling back requires a change freeze approval; exploring selective exception for support-portal.'
SRE (Emily R.) 2026-03-10 02:20: 'Patched identity-proxy in staging to do case-insensitive email lookup for approver flows; tests pass. Ready to deploy to prod with quick rollback.'
Liam Chen 2026-03-10 02:50: 'Deploying identity-proxy hotfix to us-west canary; will monitor approval flow queue.'
Support lead (Daniel K.) 2026-03-10 03:10: 'Workaround sent to teams: use manual approval in console or use one-time approval tokens until fix is verified.'
resolution_notes: 03/10 03:05 UTC - Deployed identity-proxy hotfix (case-insensitive email match) to us-west canary (1 pod).
03/10 03:30 UTC - Observed successful approval link flows on canary; increased to 50% traffic and then full us-west rollout by 03:50 UTC.
03/10 04:10 UTC - Support-portal and identity-proxy logs show no further principal-not-found errors for approval links in us-west.

03/10 08:00 UTC - Coordination with Identity team: scheduled rollback of Okta lowercase-email rule for any newly onboarded service accounts until we update our canonicalization docs (owner: Mark Lester).

Follow-up actions: update runbook to include case-insensitive lookup for email principals, add an automated E2E test that simulates Okta attribute transforms, and create a small migration script to canonicalize existing approver keys in Redis (owner: Liam Chen).
next_steps: Create Jira task to add regression test in CI for approval link SSO flows (owner: devex, due 2026-03-17).
Migrate existing approver keys to normalized-lowercase keys in Redis and add alias lookups (owner: infra, due 2026-03-20).
Coordinate with Identity team to pin Okta transform rollout plan and introduce a canary plan for tenant-level changes (owner: Mark Lester, due 2026-03-14).
